output.summary: Verified the four documented limits from the pinned workforce page in a read-only Codex documentation harness. Application Dispatch/Gatekeeper runtime was not exercised.

source_quotes: An optional repeat interval creates a scheduled agent worker; its minimum is five minutes.
A goal connects up to twelve one-time tasks in order and waits for their downstream results.
A step can additionally specify up to eight `expectations`, such as `{"path":"result.record.name","equals":"Opening Night"}` or `{"path":"result.release_id","present":true}`.
Only earlier steps can supply outputs; missing values block execution.
